CALL {
// For each pattern
MATCH (a {graph_id: $graph_id})
WHERE a.pattern_id IS NOT NULL
WITH DISTINCT a.pattern_id AS pid, a.graph_id AS graph_id

// Collect nodes in A and B for this pattern
MATCH (a1 {graph_id: $graph_id, pattern_id: pid, t: 1})
WITH pid, collect(a1) AS A, graph_id
MATCH (b1 {graph_id: $graph_id, pattern_id: pid, t: 2})
WITH pid, A, collect(b1) AS B, graph_id
WHERE size(A) + size(B) > 2

// Create new supernodes
CREATE (newA:Node {t: 2, phase: 0, pattern_id: pid, graph_id: graph_id})
CREATE (newB:Node {t: 1, phase: 0, pattern_id: pid, graph_id: graph_id})

// Reconnect edges to the new nodes
WITH A, B, pid, newA, newB
UNWIND A AS oldA
MATCH (oldA)-[r]-(other)
WHERE other.pattern_id IS NULL
CREATE (newA)-[r2:Wire]->(other)
SET r2 += properties(r)
WITH pid, B, newA, newB, collect(oldA) AS oldANodes

UNWIND B AS oldB
MATCH (oldB)-[r]-(other)
WHERE other.pattern_id IS NULL
CREATE (newB)-[r2:Wire]->(other)
SET r2 += properties(r)
WITH pid, newA, newB, oldANodes, collect(oldB) AS oldBNodes

// Connect the new supernodes
CREATE (newA)-[:Wire {t: 1, graph_id: newA.graph_id}]->(newB)

// Delete the old nodes
FOREACH (n IN oldANodes + oldBNodes | DETACH DELETE n)
RETURN pid, newA, newB
}
CALL {
  MATCH (n {graph_id: $graph_id})
  REMOVE n.pattern_id
}
RETURN pid, newA, newB;

MATCH path = (start {graph_id: $graph_id})-[:Wire*2..6]-(end)
WHERE ALL(n IN nodes(path) WHERE n.graph_id = $graph_id) AND 
  // Even length path
  size(relationships(path)) % 2 = 0
  // All edges are unmarked Hadamard edges
  AND ALL(edge IN relationships(path) WHERE edge.t = 2 AND edge.pattern_id IS NULL)
  // All intermediate nodes are unmarked identity Z-spiders
  AND ALL(node IN nodes(path)[1..-1] 
          WHERE node.t = 1 
          AND node.phase % 2 = 0 
          AND degree(node) = 2 
          AND node.pattern_id IS NULL)
  // Only process unmarked start/end nodes
  AND start.pattern_id IS NULL 
  AND end.pattern_id IS NULL

// Order by path length (longest first) and node IDs for consistency
WITH path, nodes(path) as path_nodes, relationships(path) as path_edges
ORDER BY length(path) DESC, id(nodes(path)[0]), id(nodes(path)[-1])
LIMIT 1

// Mark this pattern with unique ID
WITH path_nodes, path_edges, randomUUID() as pattern_id

// Mark all edges in the path
UNWIND path_edges AS edge
SET edge.pattern_id = pattern_id

// Mark all intermediate nodes in the path
WITH path_nodes[1..-1] as intermediate_nodes, pattern_id, path_edges
UNWIND intermediate_nodes AS node
SET node.pattern_id = pattern_id

RETURN DISTINCT pattern_id, length(path_edges) as path_length

// Find all marked patterns
MATCH (s {graph_id: $graph_id})
WHERE s.pattern_id IS NOT NULL

// Reconstruct the full path for each pattern
WITH DISTINCT s.pattern_id AS pattern_id
MATCH path = (start {graph_id: $graph_id})-[:Wire*2..6]-(end)
WHERE ALL(n IN nodes(path) WHERE n.graph_id = $graph_id)
AND ALL(edge IN relationships(path) WHERE edge.pattern_id = pattern_id)
AND start.pattern_id IS NULL AND end.pattern_id IS NULL AND id(start) < id(end)

WITH start, end, pattern_id,
      [node IN nodes(path)[1..-1] WHERE node.pattern_id = pattern_id] as nodes_to_delete

// Create direct connection
WITH DISTINCT start, end, nodes_to_delete, pattern_id
CREATE (start)-[newWire:Wire {t: 1, graph_id: $graph_id}]->(end)

// Delete the nodes with the corresponding Hadamard edges
WITH nodes_to_delete, pattern_id
UNWIND nodes_to_delete AS node
DETACH DELETE node

// Return something to ensure changes were made
WITH pattern_id
RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT pattern_id) as patterns_processed

// Phase gadget fusion (pyzx match_phase_gadgets + merge_phase_gadgets).
// A gadget is a degree-1 spider with a NON-CLIFFORD phase whose axel has a
// Pauli phase. Gadgets whose axels act on the same target set are merged:
// the surviving leaf gets the signed sum of the leaf phases (a pi on an axel
// negates that gadget's contribution), the surviving axel is zeroed, the
// other gadgets are deleted. Handles Z-gadgets (Hadamard wires) and
// X-center gadgets (simple wires).

MATCH (p:Node {graph_id: $graph_id, t: 1})
WHERE degree(p) = 1
  AND p.phase IS NOT NULL
  AND p.phase % 2 <> 0
  AND p.phase * 2 <> round(p.phase * 2)

MATCH (p)-[e:Wire]-(center:Node)
WHERE ((center.t = 1 AND e.t = 2) OR (center.t = 2 AND e.t = 1))
  AND center.phase IS NOT NULL
  AND center.phase % 2 = round(center.phase % 2)

// Target set of the gadget = the axel's other neighbors, as a sorted id list.
MATCH (center)-[target_wire:Wire]-(n:Node)
WHERE n <> p
WITH p, center, e.t AS edge_type, n, target_wire
ORDER BY id(n)
WITH p, center, edge_type, COLLECT(DISTINCT id(n)) AS neighbor_key,
     collect(n) AS targets, collect(target_wire.t) AS target_types
WHERE degree(center) = size(neighbor_key) + 1
  AND ALL(n IN targets WHERE n.t IN [1, 2] AND n <> center)
  AND ALL(i IN range(0, size(targets)-1) WHERE
    (targets[i].t = center.t AND target_types[i] = 2) OR
    (targets[i].t <> center.t AND target_types[i] = 1))

// Signed leaf phase: an axel carrying pi negates the gadget's phase.
WITH p, center, edge_type, neighbor_key,
     (CASE WHEN center.phase % 2 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) * p.phase AS signed_phase

WITH edge_type, neighbor_key,
     COLLECT(p) AS phase_spiders, COLLECT(center) AS centers,
     sum(signed_phase) AS signed_total
WHERE size(phase_spiders) > 1

WITH phase_spiders[0] AS survivor_p, centers[0] AS survivor_c,
     phase_spiders[1..] AS to_delete_p, centers[1..] AS to_delete_c,
     ((signed_total % 2) + 2) % 2 AS total_phase

SET survivor_p.phase = total_phase
SET survivor_c.phase = 0
FOREACH (p_del IN to_delete_p | DETACH DELETE p_del)
FOREACH (c_del IN to_delete_c | DETACH DELETE c_del)

RETURN count(*) AS fusions_performed

// Pivot boundary (pyzx match_pivot_boundary + pivot): interior Pauli Z-spider
// z_j whose neighbor z_alpha touches exactly ONE boundary (via a simple wire).
// z_alpha's phase is gadgetized (new axis + tip), z_j survives as a new spider
// re-pointed to the boundary with toggled wire type, bipartite edges between
// the neighbor groups are TOGGLED, z_alpha's other neighbors get +z_j, shared
// get +z_j+pi. ONE application per call; the driver loops.

MATCH (z_j:Node {graph_id: $graph_id, t: 1})-[pe:Wire {t: 2}]-(z_alpha:Node {t: 1})
WHERE z_j.phase IS NOT NULL
  AND z_j.phase % 2 = round(z_j.phase % 2)

// z_alpha touches exactly one boundary, via a simple wire.
MATCH (z_alpha)-[bw:Wire]-(bd:Node {t: 0})
WITH z_j, z_alpha, collect(DISTINCT bd) AS bds, collect(bw) AS bws
WHERE size(bds) = 1 AND ALL(w IN bws WHERE w.t = 1)
WITH z_j, z_alpha, bds[0] AS bd, bws[0] AS bw

// z_j must be interior with all-Hadamard wires, all-Z neighbors and no
// phase-gadget-tip neighbors.
OPTIONAL MATCH (z_j)-[wj:Wire]-(nj:Node)
WITH z_j, z_alpha, bd, bw, collect(DISTINCT nj) AS j_nbrs, collect(wj) AS j_wires
WHERE ALL(x IN j_nbrs WHERE x.t = 1) AND ALL(w IN j_wires WHERE w.t = 2)
  AND ALL(x IN j_nbrs WHERE degree(x) > 1)

// z_alpha's non-boundary neighbors must be Z-spiders on Hadamard wires.
OPTIONAL MATCH (z_alpha)-[wa:Wire]-(na:Node)
WHERE na.t <> 0
WITH z_j, z_alpha, bd, bw, j_nbrs, collect(DISTINCT na) AS a_nbrs, collect(wa) AS a_wires
WHERE ALL(x IN a_nbrs WHERE x.t = 1) AND ALL(w IN a_wires WHERE w.t = 2)

WITH z_j, z_alpha, bd, bw,
     [x IN j_nbrs WHERE x <> z_alpha AND NOT x IN a_nbrs] AS only_j,
     [x IN a_nbrs WHERE x <> z_j AND NOT x IN j_nbrs] AS only_alpha,
     [x IN j_nbrs WHERE x <> z_alpha AND x IN a_nbrs] AS shared
ORDER BY id(z_j), id(z_alpha)
LIMIT 1

CALL {
  WITH only_j, only_alpha
  UNWIND only_j AS u
  UNWIND only_alpha AS v
  OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[existing:Wire]-(v)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NOT NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    DELETE existing)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    CREATE (u)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: u.graph_id}]->(v))
}

CALL {
  WITH only_j, shared
  UNWIND only_j AS u
  UNWIND shared AS v
  OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[existing:Wire]-(v)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NOT NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    DELETE existing)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    CREATE (u)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: u.graph_id}]->(v))
}

CALL {
  WITH only_alpha, shared
  UNWIND only_alpha AS u
  UNWIND shared AS v
  OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[existing:Wire]-(v)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NOT NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    DELETE existing)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    CREATE (u)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: u.graph_id}]->(v))
}

FOREACH (n IN only_alpha |
  SET n.phase = (coalesce(n.phase, 0) + z_j.phase) % 2)
FOREACH (n IN shared |
  SET n.phase = (coalesce(n.phase, 0) + z_j.phase + 1) % 2)

// Surviving spider zj_new: takes z_j's phase, its exclusive/shared neighbors
// and the boundary wire with toggled type. Gadget: axis (phase = z_j's phase,
// because the axis sits in z_alpha's neighbor group of the pyzx pivot and
// receives +z_j) H-connected to the tip carrying z_alpha's phase. The axis
// connects to z_j's exclusive and shared neighbors (A-B and B-C toggles);
// zj_new itself is NOT connected to the gadget.
CREATE (zj_new:Node {t: 1, phase: z_j.phase % 2, graph_id: z_j.graph_id})
CREATE (axis:Node {t: 1, phase: z_j.phase % 2, graph_id: z_j.graph_id})
CREATE (tip:Node {t: 1, phase: ((coalesce(z_alpha.phase, 0) % 2) + 2) % 2, graph_id: z_j.graph_id})
CREATE (axis)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: z_j.graph_id}]->(tip)
CREATE (zj_new)-[:Wire {t: CASE bw.t WHEN 1 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END, graph_id: z_j.graph_id}]->(bd)
FOREACH (n IN only_j |
  CREATE (zj_new)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: z_j.graph_id}]->(n)
  CREATE (axis)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: z_j.graph_id}]->(n))
FOREACH (n IN shared |
  CREATE (zj_new)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: z_j.graph_id}]->(n)
  CREATE (axis)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: z_j.graph_id}]->(n))

DETACH DELETE z_j, z_alpha

RETURN count(*) AS pivot_operations_performed

// Interior pivot (pyzx match_pivot + pivot): two INTERIOR Pauli Z-spiders

// connected by a Hadamard edge. Interior = every wire is a Hadamard edge

// and every neighbor is a Z-spider. Toggles the complete bipartite edges

// between the exclusive/shared neighbor sets, copies b's phase onto a's

// exclusive neighbors and vice versa, adds a+b+1 to shared neighbors, then

// deletes both. ONE application per call; the driver loops.

//

// OPTIMIZED: interiorness of a and b is checked with cheap short-circuiting

// EXISTS predicates, and the O(degree) neighbour-set collection runs only

// for the single chosen pivot (after LIMIT 1) instead of for every

// Pauli-Pauli Hadamard edge in the graph.



MATCH (a:Node {graph_id: $graph_id, t: 1})-[pe:Wire {t: 2}]-(b:Node {t: 1})

WHERE id(a) < id(b)

  AND a.phase IS NOT NULL AND b.phase IS NOT NULL

  AND a.phase % 2 = round(a.phase % 2)

  AND b.phase % 2 = round(b.phase % 2)

  AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (a)-[w:Wire]-(x:Node) WHERE w.t <> 2 OR x.t <> 1 }

  AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (b)-[w:Wire]-(x:Node) WHERE w.t <> 2 OR x.t <> 1 }

WITH a, b

ORDER BY id(a), id(b)

LIMIT 1



// Collect neighbour groups for the chosen pivot only (both interior, so all

// wires are Hadamard).

OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:Wire {t: 2}]-(na:Node)

WHERE na <> b

WITH a, b, collect(DISTINCT na) AS a_nbrs

OPTIONAL MATCH (b)-[:Wire {t: 2}]-(nb:Node)

WHERE nb <> a

WITH a, b, a_nbrs, collect(DISTINCT nb) AS b_nbrs

WITH a, b,

     [x IN a_nbrs WHERE NOT x IN b_nbrs] AS only_a,

     [x IN b_nbrs WHERE NOT x IN a_nbrs] AS only_b,

     [x IN a_nbrs WHERE x IN b_nbrs] AS shared



CALL {

  WITH only_a, only_b

  UNWIND only_a AS u

  UNWIND only_b AS v

  OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[existing:Wire]-(v)

  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NOT NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |

    DELETE existing)

  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |

    CREATE (u)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: u.graph_id}]->(v))

}



CALL {

  WITH only_a, shared

  UNWIND only_a AS u

  UNWIND shared AS v

  OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[existing:Wire]-(v)

  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NOT NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |

    DELETE existing)

  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |

    CREATE (u)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: u.graph_id}]->(v))

}



CALL {

  WITH only_b, shared

  UNWIND only_b AS u

  UNWIND shared AS v

  OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[existing:Wire]-(v)

  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NOT NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |

    DELETE existing)

  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |

    CREATE (u)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: u.graph_id}]->(v))

}



FOREACH (n IN only_a |

  SET n.phase = (coalesce(n.phase, 0) + b.phase) % 2)

FOREACH (n IN only_b |

  SET n.phase = (coalesce(n.phase, 0) + a.phase) % 2)

FOREACH (n IN shared |

  SET n.phase = (coalesce(n.phase, 0) + a.phase + b.phase + 1) % 2)



DETACH DELETE a, b



RETURN count(*) AS pivot_operations_performed

// Single Pauli boundary pivot: materialize complete candidate tuples before
// taking one. Keeping separate boundary list-element references through the
// candidate stream produced incorrect boundary/phase values on Memgraph 3.6.2.
MATCH (z_j:Node {graph_id: $graph_id, t: 1})-[pe:Wire {t: 2}]-(z_alpha:Node {t: 1})
WHERE z_j.phase IS NOT NULL AND z_j.phase % 2 = round(z_j.phase % 2)
  AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (z_j)-[w:Wire]-(x) WHERE w.t <> 2 OR x.t <> 1 }
  AND z_alpha.phase IS NOT NULL AND z_alpha.phase % 2 = round(z_alpha.phase % 2)
  AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (z_alpha)-[w:Wire]-(x)
    WHERE x.t <> 0 AND (w.t <> 2 OR x.t <> 1) }
MATCH (z_alpha)-[bw:Wire]-(bd)
WHERE bd.t = 0
WITH z_j, z_alpha, id(pe) AS rank, collect(DISTINCT bd) AS bds, collect(bw) AS bws
WHERE size(bds) = 1 AND size(bws) = 1 AND degree(bds[0]) = 1
WITH z_j, z_alpha, rank, bds[0] AS bd, bws[0].t AS bt
WITH collect({j: z_j, a: z_alpha, bd: bd, bt: bt}) AS candidates
UNWIND candidates AS candidate
WITH candidate LIMIT 1
WITH candidate.j AS z_j, candidate.a AS z_alpha, candidate.bd AS bd, candidate.bt AS bt
OPTIONAL MATCH (z_j)-[:Wire {t: 2}]-(nj)
WHERE nj <> z_alpha
WITH z_j, z_alpha, bd, bt, collect(DISTINCT nj) AS j_nbrs
OPTIONAL MATCH (z_alpha)-[:Wire {t: 2}]-(na)
WHERE na <> z_j AND na <> bd
WITH z_j, z_alpha, bd, bt, j_nbrs, collect(DISTINCT na) AS a_nbrs
WITH z_j, z_alpha, bd, bt,
     [x IN j_nbrs WHERE NOT x IN a_nbrs] AS only_j,
     [x IN a_nbrs WHERE NOT x IN j_nbrs] AS only_alpha,
     [x IN j_nbrs WHERE x IN a_nbrs] AS shared

CALL {
  WITH only_j, only_alpha
  UNWIND only_j AS u
  UNWIND only_alpha AS v
  OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[existing:Wire]-(v)
  WITH u, v, collect(existing) AS existing_edges
  FOREACH (edge IN existing_edges | DELETE edge)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN size(existing_edges) = 0 THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    CREATE (u)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: u.graph_id}]->(v))
}

CALL {
  WITH only_j, shared
  UNWIND only_j AS u
  UNWIND shared AS v
  OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[existing:Wire]-(v)
  WITH u, v, collect(existing) AS existing_edges
  FOREACH (edge IN existing_edges | DELETE edge)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN size(existing_edges) = 0 THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    CREATE (u)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: u.graph_id}]->(v))
}

CALL {
  WITH only_alpha, shared
  UNWIND only_alpha AS u
  UNWIND shared AS v
  OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[existing:Wire]-(v)
  WITH u, v, collect(existing) AS existing_edges
  FOREACH (edge IN existing_edges | DELETE edge)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN size(existing_edges) = 0 THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    CREATE (u)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: u.graph_id}]->(v))
}

FOREACH (n IN only_j |
  SET n.phase = (coalesce(n.phase, 0) + z_alpha.phase) % 2)
FOREACH (n IN only_alpha |
  SET n.phase = (coalesce(n.phase, 0) + z_j.phase) % 2)
FOREACH (n IN shared |
  SET n.phase = (coalesce(n.phase, 0) + z_j.phase + z_alpha.phase + 1) % 2)
CREATE (z_j)-[:Wire {t: CASE bt WHEN 1 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END, graph_id: z_j.graph_id}]->(bd)
DETACH DELETE z_alpha
RETURN count(*) AS interior_pauli_removed

MATCH (n {graph_id: $graph_id})
OPTIONAL MATCH (n {graph_id: $graph_id})--(m)
WITH n, count(m) AS degree
WITH degree, count(*) AS frequency
RETURN degree, frequency
ORDER BY degree;

// Supplementarity (type 1): two Z-spiders, not adjacent, same neighborhood,
// non-Clifford phases with sum or difference odd. Both deleted;
// neighbors' phases get +1 only when the SUM is odd (pyzx apply_supplementarity).

MATCH (v:Node {graph_id: $graph_id, t: 1})
WHERE v.phase IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT (v)-[:Wire {t: 1}]-()
  AND NOT (v)-[:Wire]-(v)
  AND v.phase * 2 <> round(v.phase * 2)

OPTIONAL MATCH (v)-[:Wire]-(n)
WITH v, collect(DISTINCT n) AS v_neigh
WHERE degree(v) = size(v_neigh) + 0 AND ALL(n IN v_neigh WHERE n.t = 1)

MATCH (w:Node {graph_id: $graph_id, t: 1})
WHERE id(w) > id(v)
  AND w.phase IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT (w)-[:Wire {t: 1}]-()
  AND NOT (w)-[:Wire]-(w)
  AND w.phase * 2 <> round(w.phase * 2)
  AND ((v.phase + w.phase) % 2 = 1 OR abs((v.phase - w.phase) % 2) = 1)
  AND NOT (v)-[:Wire]-(w)

OPTIONAL MATCH (w)-[:Wire]-(m)
WITH v, w, v_neigh, collect(DISTINCT m) AS w_neigh
WHERE degree(w) = size(w_neigh) + 0 AND ALL(n IN w_neigh WHERE n.t = 1)
  AND size(v_neigh) = size(w_neigh)
  AND ALL(x IN v_neigh WHERE x IN w_neigh)

WITH v, w, v_neigh
ORDER BY id(v), id(w)
LIMIT 1

FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN (v.phase + w.phase) % 2 = 1 THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
  FOREACH (n IN v_neigh |
    FOREACH (__ IN CASE WHEN n.phase IS NOT NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
      SET n.phase = (n.phase + 1) % 2
    )
  )
)

WITH v, w
DETACH DELETE v, w

RETURN count(*) AS supplementarity_applied

// Supplementarity (type 2): two adjacent Z-spiders with same external neighborhood,
// non-Clifford phases with sum even or difference odd (pyzx match_supplementarity).
// Both deleted; external neighbors get +1 only when the sum is even.

MATCH (v:Node {graph_id: $graph_id, t: 1})-[:Wire]-(w:Node {t: 1})
WHERE id(v) < id(w)
  AND v.phase IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT (v)-[:Wire {t: 1}]-()
  AND NOT (v)-[:Wire]-(v)
  AND v.phase * 2 <> round(v.phase * 2)
  AND w.phase IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT (w)-[:Wire {t: 1}]-()
  AND NOT (w)-[:Wire]-(w)
  AND w.phase * 2 <> round(w.phase * 2)
  AND ((v.phase + w.phase) % 2 = 0 OR abs((v.phase - w.phase) % 2) = 1)

OPTIONAL MATCH (v)-[:Wire]-(n)
WHERE n <> w
WITH v, w, collect(DISTINCT n) AS v_ext_neigh
WHERE degree(v) = size(v_ext_neigh) + 1 AND ALL(n IN v_ext_neigh WHERE n.t = 1)

OPTIONAL MATCH (w)-[:Wire]-(m)
WHERE m <> v
WITH v, w, v_ext_neigh, collect(DISTINCT m) AS w_ext_neigh
WHERE degree(w) = size(w_ext_neigh) + 1 AND ALL(n IN w_ext_neigh WHERE n.t = 1)
  AND size(v_ext_neigh) = size(w_ext_neigh)
  AND ALL(x IN v_ext_neigh WHERE x IN w_ext_neigh)

WITH v, w, v_ext_neigh
ORDER BY id(v), id(w)
LIMIT 1

FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN (v.phase + w.phase) % 2 = 0 THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
  FOREACH (n IN v_ext_neigh |
    FOREACH (__ IN CASE WHEN n.phase IS NOT NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
      SET n.phase = (n.phase + 1) % 2
    )
  )
)

WITH v, w
DETACH DELETE v, w

RETURN count(*) AS supplementarity_applied

// Cancel pairs of Hadamard wires between equal colors, or simple wires
// between opposite colors (the color-dual Hopf rule).

MATCH (a:Node {graph_id: $graph_id})-[r:Wire]-(b:Node)
WHERE id(a) < id(b) AND a.t IN [1, 2] AND b.t IN [1, 2]
  AND ((a.t = b.t AND r.t = 2) OR (a.t <> b.t AND r.t = 1))
WITH a, b, collect(DISTINCT r) AS rs
WHERE size(rs) >= 2
WITH rs, size(rs) - (size(rs) % 2) AS k
UNWIND rs[0..k] AS r
DELETE r
RETURN count(*) AS removed

// A mixed pair retains the copying wire and adds pi to one endpoint.
// Equal colors: retain simple, remove H. Opposite colors: retain H, remove
// simple. The latter is obtained by color-changing one endpoint.

MATCH (a:Node {graph_id: $graph_id})-[s:Wire]-(b:Node), (a)-[h:Wire]-(b)
WHERE id(a) < id(b) AND a.t IN [1, 2] AND b.t IN [1, 2]
  AND ((a.t = b.t AND s.t = 1 AND h.t = 2)
       OR (a.t <> b.t AND s.t = 2 AND h.t = 1))
WITH a, b, head(collect(DISTINCT h)) AS h1
DELETE h1
SET a.phase = (coalesce(a.phase, 0) + 1) % 2
RETURN count(*) AS removed

// Collapse duplicate copying wires: simple wires between equal colors,
// or Hadamard wires between opposite colors. Keep exactly one.

MATCH (a:Node {graph_id: $graph_id})-[r:Wire]-(b:Node)
WHERE id(a) < id(b) AND a.t IN [1, 2] AND b.t IN [1, 2]
  AND ((a.t = b.t AND r.t = 1) OR (a.t <> b.t AND r.t = 2))
WITH a, b, collect(DISTINCT r) AS rs
WHERE size(rs) >= 2
UNWIND rs[1..] AS r
DELETE r
RETURN count(*) AS removed

// pyzx match_phase_gadgets normalizes every phase gadget whose axel
// carries pi: the leaf phase is negated and the axel zeroed. Running this
// before gadget fusion keeps DB results isomorphic to pyzx gadget_simp.

MATCH (p:Node {graph_id: $graph_id, t: 1})
WHERE degree(p) = 1
  AND p.phase IS NOT NULL
  AND p.phase % 2 <> 0
  AND p.phase * 2 <> round(p.phase * 2)

MATCH (p)-[e:Wire]-(center:Node)
WHERE ((center.t = 1 AND e.t = 2) OR (center.t = 2 AND e.t = 1))
  AND center.phase IS NOT NULL
  AND abs(center.phase % 2) = 1

SET p.phase = (((-p.phase) % 2) + 2) % 2
SET center.phase = 0

RETURN count(*) AS normalized

// Bialgebra (pyzx >= 0.10 bialg_simp / check_bialgebra_reduce +

// unsafe_bialgebra): a single simple wire between a PAULI Z-spider and a

// PAULI X-spider, where the Z's other neighbors are all phase-0 X-spiders

// and the X's other neighbors are all phase-0 Z-spiders. Every other wire

// of each center receives a NEW spider of the OPPOSITE center's color

// carrying the OPPOSITE center's phase (attached with that wire's type);

// the new spiders are marked with bialg_side for the follow-up query that

// connects the two sides completely bipartitely. Both centers are deleted.

// ONE application per call; the driver loops and runs 'Bialgebra connect'

// after each application.

MATCH (v0:Node {graph_id: $graph_id, t: 1})-[e:Wire {t: 1}]-(v1:Node {t: 2})

WHERE v0.phase IS NOT NULL AND v0.phase % 2 = round(v0.phase % 2)

  AND v1.phase IS NOT NULL AND v1.phase % 2 = round(v1.phase % 2)

  // no self-loops (Memgraph only allows pattern predicates in a MATCH WHERE)

  AND NOT (v0)-[:Wire]-(v0) AND NOT (v1)-[:Wire]-(v1)

// exactly one wire between the centers

MATCH (v0)-[es:Wire]-(v1)

WITH v0, v1, count(es) AS n_edges

WHERE n_edges = 1

OPTIONAL MATCH (v0)-[w0:Wire]-(n0:Node)

WHERE n0 <> v1

WITH v0, v1, collect(DISTINCT n0) AS v0n

WHERE ALL(x IN v0n WHERE x.t = 2 AND x.phase IS NOT NULL AND x.phase % 2 = 0)

OPTIONAL MATCH (v1)-[w1:Wire]-(n1:Node)

WHERE n1 <> v0

WITH v0, v1, collect(DISTINCT n1) AS v1n

WHERE ALL(x IN v1n WHERE x.t = 1 AND x.phase IS NOT NULL AND x.phase % 2 = 0)

WITH v0, v1,

     ((v0.phase % 2) + 2) % 2 AS ph0,

     ((v1.phase % 2) + 2) % 2 AS ph1

ORDER BY id(v0), id(v1)

LIMIT 1

// Materialize both neighborhoods and wire types before creating or deleting.
// DISTINCT alone need not drain a lazy adjacency expansion before mutation.
OPTIONAL MATCH (v0)-[e0:Wire]-(n0:Node)
WHERE n0 <> v1
WITH v0, v1, ph0, ph1,
     collect(CASE WHEN n0 IS NULL THEN null ELSE {node: n0, t: e0.t} END) AS left
OPTIONAL MATCH (v1)-[e1:Wire]-(n1:Node)
WHERE n1 <> v0
WITH v0, v1, ph0, ph1, left, v0.graph_id AS gid,
     collect(CASE WHEN n1 IS NULL THEN null ELSE {node: n1, t: e1.t} END) AS right
FOREACH (item IN left |
  FOREACH (neighbor IN [item.node] |
    CREATE (:Node {t: 2, phase: ph1, graph_id: gid, bialg_side: 0})
      -[:Wire {t: item.t, graph_id: gid}]->(neighbor)))
FOREACH (item IN right |
  FOREACH (neighbor IN [item.node] |
    CREATE (:Node {t: 1, phase: ph0, graph_id: gid, bialg_side: 1})
      -[:Wire {t: item.t, graph_id: gid}]->(neighbor)))
DETACH DELETE v0, v1
RETURN count(*) AS bialg_applied

// to_gh step 2: every X-spider becomes a Z-spider.

MATCH (v:Node {graph_id: $graph_id, t: 2})
// Materialize before mutating the indexed vertex type.
WITH collect(v) AS spiders
UNWIND spiders AS v
SET v.t = 1
RETURN count(*) AS recolored

// Drop nonzero isolated scalar factors under projective semantics.
// An isolated Z/X spider at an odd pi phase is exactly zero and must survive.
MATCH (n:Node {graph_id: $graph_id})
WHERE degree(n) = 0
  AND NOT (n.t IN [1, 2] AND ((coalesce(n.phase, 0) % 2 + 2) % 2) = 1)
DETACH DELETE n
RETURN count(*) AS removed

// Second step of the bialgebra rewrite: connect the side-0 and side-1
// spiders created by 'Bialgebra rule' completely bipartitely with simple
// wires, then clear the markers.

OPTIONAL MATCH (a:Node {graph_id: $graph_id}) WHERE a.bialg_side = 0
WITH collect(a) AS side0
OPTIONAL MATCH (b:Node {graph_id: $graph_id}) WHERE b.bialg_side = 1
WITH side0, collect(b) AS side1
UNWIND (CASE WHEN size(side0) = 0 THEN [null] ELSE side0 END) AS a
UNWIND (CASE WHEN size(side1) = 0 THEN [null] ELSE side1 END) AS b
FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN a IS NOT NULL AND b IS NOT NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
  CREATE (a)-[:Wire {t: 1, graph_id: a.graph_id}]->(b)
)
WITH count(*) AS done
MATCH (n:Node {graph_id: $graph_id}) WHERE n.bialg_side IS NOT NULL
REMOVE n.bialg_side
RETURN count(*) AS cleared

items.title: Pivot rule - single interior Pauli spider original

code.value:
// Boundary pivot (pyzx pivot with one boundary): interior Pauli Z-spider `a`
// H-connected to Pauli Z-spider `b` that touches exactly ONE boundary; all
// other neighbors of both are Z-spiders on Hadamard edges. Performs the full
// pivot: toggles bipartite edges between exclusive/shared neighbor groups,
// copies phases (a's exclusive neighbors get b's phase and vice versa, shared
// get a+b+pi), re-points the boundary wire to `a` with toggled edge type and
// deletes `b` (`a` survives). ONE application per call; the driver loops.

MATCH (a:Node {graph_id: $graph_id, t: 1})-[pe:Wire {t: 2}]-(b:Node {t: 1})
WHERE a.phase IS NOT NULL AND b.phase IS NOT NULL
  AND a.phase % 2 = round(a.phase % 2)
  AND b.phase % 2 = round(b.phase % 2)

// a must be interior
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[wa:Wire]-(na:Node)
WITH a, b, collect(DISTINCT na) AS a_nbrs, collect(wa) AS a_wires
WHERE ALL(x IN a_nbrs WHERE x.t = 1) AND ALL(w IN a_wires WHERE w.t = 2)

// b touches exactly one boundary
MATCH (b)-[be:Wire]-(bd:Node {t: 0})
WITH a, b, a_nbrs, collect(DISTINCT bd) AS bds, collect(be) AS bes
WHERE size(bds) = 1
WITH a, b, a_nbrs, bds[0] AS bd, bes[0] AS be

// b's non-boundary neighbors must be Z-spiders on Hadamard edges
OPTIONAL MATCH (b)-[wz:Wire]-(nz:Node)
WHERE nz.t <> 0
WITH a, b, bd, be, a_nbrs, collect(DISTINCT nz) AS b_zn, collect(wz) AS b_zw
WHERE ALL(x IN b_zn WHERE x.t = 1) AND ALL(w IN b_zw WHERE w.t = 2)

WITH a, b, bd, be,
     [x IN a_nbrs WHERE x <> b AND NOT x IN b_zn] AS only_a,
     [x IN b_zn WHERE x <> a AND NOT x IN a_nbrs] AS only_b,
     [x IN a_nbrs WHERE x <> b AND x IN b_zn] AS shared
ORDER BY id(a), id(b)
LIMIT 1

CALL {
  WITH only_a, only_b
  UNWIND only_a AS u
  UNWIND only_b AS v
  OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[existing:Wire]-(v)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NOT NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    DELETE existing)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    CREATE (u)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: u.graph_id}]->(v))
}

CALL {
  WITH only_a, shared
  UNWIND only_a AS u
  UNWIND shared AS v
  OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[existing:Wire]-(v)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NOT NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    DELETE existing)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    CREATE (u)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: u.graph_id}]->(v))
}

CALL {
  WITH only_b, shared
  UNWIND only_b AS u
  UNWIND shared AS v
  OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[existing:Wire]-(v)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NOT NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    DELETE existing)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    CREATE (u)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: u.graph_id}]->(v))
}

FOREACH (n IN only_a |
  SET n.phase = (coalesce(n.phase, 0) + b.phase) % 2)
FOREACH (n IN only_b |
  SET n.phase = (coalesce(n.phase, 0) + a.phase) % 2)
FOREACH (n IN shared |
  SET n.phase = (coalesce(n.phase, 0) + a.phase + b.phase + 1) % 2)

// Re-point the boundary wire to a with toggled edge type, delete b.
WITH a, b, bd, CASE be.t WHEN 1 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS new_t
CREATE (a)-[:Wire {t: new_t, graph_id: a.graph_id}]->(bd)
DETACH DELETE b

RETURN count(*) AS interior_pauli_removed

items.title: Pivot rule - two interior Pauli spiders original

code.value:
// Interior pivot (pyzx match_pivot_parallel + pivot): two INTERIOR Pauli
// Z-spiders connected by a Hadamard edge. Interior = every wire is a Hadamard
// edge and every neighbor is a Z-spider. Toggles the complete bipartite edges
// between the exclusive/shared neighbor sets, copies b's phase onto a's
// exclusive neighbors and vice versa, adds a+b+1 to shared neighbors, then
// deletes both. ONE application per call; the driver loops.

MATCH (a:Node {graph_id: $graph_id, t: 1})-[pe:Wire {t: 2}]-(b:Node {t: 1})
WHERE id(a) < id(b)
  AND a.phase IS NOT NULL AND b.phase IS NOT NULL
  AND a.phase % 2 = round(a.phase % 2)
  AND b.phase % 2 = round(b.phase % 2)

OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[wa:Wire]-(na:Node)
WITH a, b, collect(DISTINCT na) AS a_nbrs, collect(wa) AS a_wires
WHERE ALL(x IN a_nbrs WHERE x.t = 1) AND ALL(w IN a_wires WHERE w.t = 2)

OPTIONAL MATCH (b)-[wb:Wire]-(nb:Node)
WITH a, b, a_nbrs, collect(DISTINCT nb) AS b_nbrs, collect(wb) AS b_wires
WHERE ALL(x IN b_nbrs WHERE x.t = 1) AND ALL(w IN b_wires WHERE w.t = 2)

WITH a, b,
     [x IN a_nbrs WHERE x <> b AND NOT x IN b_nbrs] AS only_a,
     [x IN b_nbrs WHERE x <> a AND NOT x IN a_nbrs] AS only_b,
     [x IN a_nbrs WHERE x <> b AND x IN b_nbrs] AS shared
ORDER BY id(a), id(b)
LIMIT 1

// Toggle Hadamard edges between the three neighbor groups.
CALL {
  WITH only_a, only_b
  UNWIND only_a AS u
  UNWIND only_b AS v
  OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[existing:Wire]-(v)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NOT NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    DELETE existing)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    CREATE (u)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: u.graph_id}]->(v))
}

CALL {
  WITH only_a, shared
  UNWIND only_a AS u
  UNWIND shared AS v
  OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[existing:Wire]-(v)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NOT NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    DELETE existing)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    CREATE (u)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: u.graph_id}]->(v))
}

CALL {
  WITH only_b, shared
  UNWIND only_b AS u
  UNWIND shared AS v
  OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[existing:Wire]-(v)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NOT NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    DELETE existing)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    CREATE (u)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: u.graph_id}]->(v))
}

// pyzx pivot: a's exclusive neighbors receive b's phase and vice versa;
// shared neighbors receive a + b + pi.
FOREACH (n IN only_a |
  SET n.phase = (coalesce(n.phase, 0) + b.phase) % 2)
FOREACH (n IN only_b |
  SET n.phase = (coalesce(n.phase, 0) + a.phase) % 2)
FOREACH (n IN shared |
  SET n.phase = (coalesce(n.phase, 0) + a.phase + b.phase + 1) % 2)

DETACH DELETE a, b

RETURN count(*) AS pivot_operations_performed

items.title: Pivot rule - batched interior Pauli spiders

code.value:
// Greedy independent local complementations with disjoint closed neighborhoods.
MATCH (center:Node {graph_id: $graph_id, t: 1})
WHERE center.phase = 0.5 OR center.phase = 1.5

OPTIONAL MATCH (center)-[w:Wire]-(nbr:Node)
WITH center, collect(DISTINCT nbr) AS neighbors, collect(w) AS wires
WHERE ALL(x IN neighbors WHERE x.t = 1)
  AND ALL(w IN wires WHERE w.t = 2)

// Smaller neighborhoods require fewer edge toggles.
WITH center, neighbors ORDER BY size(neighbors), id(center)
WITH collect({center: center, neighbors: neighbors,
              rank: id(center), claim: [center] + neighbors}) AS candidates
WITH reduce(selected = {used: [], matches: []}, candidate IN candidates |
  CASE WHEN any(v IN candidate.claim WHERE v IN selected.used) THEN selected
       ELSE {used: selected.used + candidate.claim,
             matches: selected.matches + [candidate]} END) AS selected
UNWIND selected.matches AS candidate
WITH candidate.center AS center, candidate.neighbors AS neighbors

// A write-only subquery preserves the center even when there are no pairs.
CALL {
  WITH center, neighbors
  UNWIND CASE WHEN size(neighbors) >= 2 THEN range(0, size(neighbors)-2) ELSE [] END AS i
  WITH neighbors[i] AS u, neighbors[i+1..] AS targets, center
  CALL {
    WITH u, targets
    OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[edge:Wire {t: 2}]-(v)
    WHERE v IN targets
    RETURN collect(edge) AS existing, collect(v) AS connected
  }
  WITH u, center, existing, [v IN targets WHERE NOT v IN connected] AS missing
  FOREACH (edge IN existing | DELETE edge)
  FOREACH (v IN missing | CREATE (u)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: center.graph_id}]->(v))
}

FOREACH (n IN neighbors |
  SET n.phase = ((coalesce(n.phase, 0) - center.phase) % 2 + 2) % 2
)

DETACH DELETE center

RETURN count(*) AS patterns_processed

// Batched gadget pivot: greedily retain candidates whose closed neighborhoods
// do not intersect an earlier winner. Materialize candidates before mutation.
MATCH (z_j:Node {graph_id: $graph_id, t: 1})-[pe:Wire {t: 2}]-(z_alpha:Node {t: 1})
WHERE z_j.phase IS NOT NULL AND z_alpha.phase IS NOT NULL
  AND z_j.phase % 2 = round(z_j.phase % 2)
  AND z_alpha.phase % 2 <> 0 AND abs(z_alpha.phase % 2) <> 1
  AND degree(z_alpha) > 1
  // z_j interior: every wire Hadamard, every neighbor a Z-spider,
  // and z_j is not a phase-gadget axis (no degree-1 neighbor).
  AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (z_j)-[w:Wire]-(x:Node) WHERE w.t <> 2 OR x.t <> 1 }
  AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (z_j)-[:Wire]-(x:Node) WHERE degree(x) = 1 }
  // z_alpha interior.
  AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (z_alpha)-[w:Wire]-(x:Node) WHERE w.t <> 2 OR x.t <> 1 }
// Neighbor variables deliberately omit redundant labels: on Memgraph 3.6.2
// labeling them can select ScanAll per candidate instead of bound expansion.
WITH DISTINCT z_j, z_alpha, id(pe) AS rank
ORDER BY rank
WITH z_j, head(collect({a: z_alpha, rank: rank})) AS choice
WITH z_j, choice.a AS z_alpha, choice.rank AS rank
OPTIONAL MATCH (z_j)-[:Wire {t: 2}]-(nj)
WITH z_j, z_alpha, rank, collect(DISTINCT nj) AS j_claim
OPTIONAL MATCH (z_alpha)-[:Wire {t: 2}]-(na)
WITH z_j, z_alpha, rank, j_claim, collect(DISTINCT na) AS a_claim
ORDER BY rank
WITH collect({j: z_j, a: z_alpha, rank: rank,
              claim: [z_j, z_alpha] + j_claim + a_claim}) AS candidates
WITH reduce(selected = {used: [], matches: []}, candidate IN candidates |
  CASE WHEN any(v IN candidate.claim WHERE v IN selected.used) THEN selected
       ELSE {used: selected.used + candidate.claim,
             matches: selected.matches + [candidate]} END) AS selected
UNWIND selected.matches AS candidate
WITH candidate.j AS z_j, candidate.a AS z_alpha

// Collect neighbor groups for each independent winner.
OPTIONAL MATCH (z_j)-[:Wire {t: 2}]-(nj)
WHERE nj <> z_alpha
WITH z_j, z_alpha, collect(DISTINCT nj) AS j_nbrs
OPTIONAL MATCH (z_alpha)-[:Wire {t: 2}]-(na)
WHERE na <> z_j
WITH z_j, z_alpha, j_nbrs, collect(DISTINCT na) AS a_nbrs
WITH z_j, z_alpha,
     [x IN j_nbrs WHERE NOT x IN a_nbrs] AS only_j,
     [x IN a_nbrs WHERE NOT x IN j_nbrs] AS only_alpha,
     [x IN j_nbrs WHERE x IN a_nbrs] AS shared

CALL {
  WITH only_j, only_alpha
  UNWIND only_j AS u
  // Expand each source once, rather than once per potential target.
  OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[existing:Wire {t: 2}]-(neighbor)
  WHERE neighbor IN only_alpha
  WITH u, only_alpha, collect(existing) AS existing_edges, collect(neighbor) AS connected
  WITH u, existing_edges, [v IN only_alpha WHERE NOT v IN connected] AS missing
  FOREACH (edge IN existing_edges | DELETE edge)
  // Simple edges remain; a new parallel H edge is normalized by the caller.
  FOREACH (v IN missing |
    CREATE (u)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: u.graph_id}]->(v))
}

CALL {
  WITH only_j, shared
  UNWIND only_j AS u
  // Expand each source once, rather than once per potential target.
  OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[existing:Wire {t: 2}]-(neighbor)
  WHERE neighbor IN shared
  WITH u, shared, collect(existing) AS existing_edges, collect(neighbor) AS connected
  WITH u, existing_edges, [v IN shared WHERE NOT v IN connected] AS missing
  FOREACH (edge IN existing_edges | DELETE edge)
  // Simple edges remain; a new parallel H edge is normalized by the caller.
  FOREACH (v IN missing |
    CREATE (u)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: u.graph_id}]->(v))
}

CALL {
  WITH only_alpha, shared
  UNWIND only_alpha AS u
  // Expand each source once, rather than once per potential target.
  OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[existing:Wire {t: 2}]-(neighbor)
  WHERE neighbor IN shared
  WITH u, shared, collect(existing) AS existing_edges, collect(neighbor) AS connected
  WITH u, existing_edges, [v IN shared WHERE NOT v IN connected] AS missing
  FOREACH (edge IN existing_edges | DELETE edge)
  // Simple edges remain; a new parallel H edge is normalized by the caller.
  FOREACH (v IN missing |
    CREATE (u)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: u.graph_id}]->(v))
}

FOREACH (n IN only_alpha |
  SET n.phase = (coalesce(n.phase, 0) + z_j.phase) % 2)
FOREACH (n IN shared |
  SET n.phase = (coalesce(n.phase, 0) + z_j.phase + 1) % 2)

// Gadgetize: axis takes over z_j (its phase, its exclusive and shared
// neighbors) and is H-connected to the tip carrying z_alpha's phase.
CREATE (axis:Node {t: 1, phase: z_j.phase % 2, graph_id: z_j.graph_id})
CREATE (tip:Node {t: 1, phase: ((z_alpha.phase % 2) + 2) % 2, graph_id: z_j.graph_id})
CREATE (axis)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: z_j.graph_id}]->(tip)
FOREACH (n IN only_j | CREATE (axis)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: z_j.graph_id}]->(n))
FOREACH (n IN shared | CREATE (axis)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: z_j.graph_id}]->(n))

DETACH DELETE z_j, z_alpha

RETURN count(*) AS pivot_operations_performed

// Boundary pivot batches: each candidate claims both centers, their neighbors,
// and its boundary. Minimum edge-rank ownership selects disjoint closed
// neighborhoods. Winners are materialized before any mutation.
MATCH (z_j:Node {graph_id: $graph_id, t: 1})-[pe:Wire {t: 2}]-(z_alpha:Node {t: 1})
WHERE z_j.phase IS NOT NULL AND z_j.phase % 2 = round(z_j.phase % 2)
  AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (z_j)-[w:Wire]-(x) WHERE w.t <> 2 OR x.t <> 1 }
  AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (z_j)-[:Wire]-(x) WHERE degree(x) = 1 }
  AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (z_alpha)-[w:Wire]-(x)
    WHERE x.t <> 0 AND (w.t <> 2 OR x.t <> 1) }
MATCH (z_alpha)-[bw:Wire]-(bd)
WHERE bd.t = 0
WITH z_j, z_alpha, id(pe) AS rank, collect(DISTINCT bd) AS bds, collect(bw) AS bws
WHERE size(bds) = 1 AND size(bws) = 1 AND bws[0].t = 1 AND degree(bds[0]) = 1
WITH z_j, z_alpha, rank, bds[0] AS bd
// At most one partner per interior center can be rewritten in a batch.
// Choose its minimum-rank eligible partner before expanding neighborhood claims.
WITH z_j, collect({a: z_alpha, bd: bd, rank: rank}) AS partners, min(rank) AS best
UNWIND partners AS partner
WITH z_j, partner, best WHERE partner.rank = best
WITH z_j, partner.a AS z_alpha, partner.bd AS bd, partner.rank AS rank
// Avoid redundant neighbor labels: these cause per-candidate ScanAll plans
// on Memgraph 3.6.2 instead of expansion from the bound centers.
OPTIONAL MATCH (z_j)-[:Wire]-(nj)
WITH z_j, z_alpha, bd, rank, collect(DISTINCT nj) AS j_claim
OPTIONAL MATCH (z_alpha)-[:Wire]-(na)
WITH z_j, z_alpha, bd, rank, j_claim, collect(DISTINCT na) AS a_claim
WITH collect({j: z_j, a: z_alpha, bd: bd, rank: rank,
              claim: [z_j, z_alpha, bd] + j_claim + a_claim}) AS candidates
UNWIND candidates AS candidate
UNWIND candidate.claim AS v
// Claimants store [rank, interior, boundary-adjacent, boundary]. Do not copy
// the full neighborhood list into every per-vertex ownership group.
WITH v, collect([candidate.rank, candidate.j, candidate.a, candidate.bd]) AS claimants, min(candidate.rank) AS owner
UNWIND claimants AS candidate
WITH candidate AS candidate,
     sum(CASE WHEN candidate[0] = owner THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS conflicts
WHERE conflicts = 0
WITH collect({j: candidate[1], a: candidate[2], bd: candidate[3]}) AS survivors
UNWIND survivors AS candidate
WITH candidate.j AS z_j, candidate.a AS z_alpha, candidate.bd AS bd
OPTIONAL MATCH (z_j)-[:Wire {t: 2}]-(nj)
WHERE nj <> z_alpha
WITH z_j, z_alpha, bd, collect(DISTINCT nj) AS j_nbrs
OPTIONAL MATCH (z_alpha)-[:Wire {t: 2}]-(na)
WHERE na <> z_j AND na <> bd
WITH z_j, z_alpha, bd, j_nbrs, collect(DISTINCT na) AS a_nbrs
WITH z_j, z_alpha, bd,
     [x IN j_nbrs WHERE NOT x IN a_nbrs] AS only_j,
     [x IN a_nbrs WHERE NOT x IN j_nbrs] AS only_alpha,
     [x IN j_nbrs WHERE x IN a_nbrs] AS shared

CALL {
  WITH only_j, only_alpha
  UNWIND only_j AS u
  // Expand each source once, rather than once per potential target.
  OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[existing:Wire {t: 2}]-(neighbor)
  WHERE neighbor IN only_alpha
  WITH u, only_alpha, collect(existing) AS existing_edges, collect(neighbor) AS connected
  WITH u, existing_edges, [v IN only_alpha WHERE NOT v IN connected] AS missing
  FOREACH (edge IN existing_edges | DELETE edge)
  // Simple edges remain; a new parallel H edge is normalized by the caller.
  FOREACH (v IN missing |
    CREATE (u)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: u.graph_id}]->(v))
}

CALL {
  WITH only_j, shared
  UNWIND only_j AS u
  // Expand each source once, rather than once per potential target.
  OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[existing:Wire {t: 2}]-(neighbor)
  WHERE neighbor IN shared
  WITH u, shared, collect(existing) AS existing_edges, collect(neighbor) AS connected
  WITH u, existing_edges, [v IN shared WHERE NOT v IN connected] AS missing
  FOREACH (edge IN existing_edges | DELETE edge)
  // Simple edges remain; a new parallel H edge is normalized by the caller.
  FOREACH (v IN missing |
    CREATE (u)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: u.graph_id}]->(v))
}

CALL {
  WITH only_alpha, shared
  UNWIND only_alpha AS u
  // Expand each source once, rather than once per potential target.
  OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[existing:Wire {t: 2}]-(neighbor)
  WHERE neighbor IN shared
  WITH u, shared, collect(existing) AS existing_edges, collect(neighbor) AS connected
  WITH u, existing_edges, [v IN shared WHERE NOT v IN connected] AS missing
  FOREACH (edge IN existing_edges | DELETE edge)
  // Simple edges remain; a new parallel H edge is normalized by the caller.
  FOREACH (v IN missing |
    CREATE (u)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: u.graph_id}]->(v))
}

FOREACH (n IN only_alpha |
  SET n.phase = (coalesce(n.phase, 0) + z_j.phase) % 2)
FOREACH (n IN shared |
  SET n.phase = (coalesce(n.phase, 0) + z_j.phase + 1) % 2)

// Retain z_j and its existing exclusive/shared wires. Only z_alpha is
// deleted; the new boundary wire and gadget supply the remaining pivot edges.
CREATE (axis:Node {t: 1, phase: z_j.phase % 2, graph_id: z_j.graph_id})
CREATE (tip:Node {t: 1, phase: ((coalesce(z_alpha.phase, 0) % 2) + 2) % 2, graph_id: z_j.graph_id})
CREATE (axis)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: z_j.graph_id}]->(tip)
CREATE (z_j)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: z_j.graph_id}]->(bd)
FOREACH (n IN only_j |
  CREATE (axis)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: z_j.graph_id}]->(n))
FOREACH (n IN shared |
  CREATE (axis)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: z_j.graph_id}]->(n))

DETACH DELETE z_alpha

RETURN count(*) AS pivot_operations_performed

CALL {
  MATCH (v:_ZXdbPivotEligible {graph_id: $graph_id})
  REMOVE v:_ZXdbPivotEligible
}
// Cache interior eligibility once instead of scanning it for each boundary partner.
MATCH (v:Node {graph_id: $graph_id, t: 1})
WHERE v.phase IS NOT NULL AND v.phase % 2 = round(v.phase % 2)
  AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (v)-[w:Wire]-(x) WHERE w.t <> 2 OR x.t <> 1 }
SET v:_ZXdbPivotEligible
WITH count(v) AS tagged
// Pauli boundary pivot batches: each candidate claims both centers, their neighbors,
// and its boundary. Greedy rank-ordered selection retains disjoint closed
// neighborhoods. Winners are materialized before any mutation.
// Materialize boundary candidates before searching for an interior partner.
// This avoids testing every interior edge on dense graphs with few boundaries.
MATCH (z_alpha:Node {graph_id: $graph_id, t: 1})-[bw:Wire]-(bd)
WHERE bd.t = 0
  AND z_alpha.phase IS NOT NULL AND z_alpha.phase % 2 = round(z_alpha.phase % 2)
WITH z_alpha, collect(DISTINCT bd) AS bds, collect(bw) AS bws
WHERE size(bds) = 1 AND size(bws) = 1 AND degree(bds[0]) = 1
  AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (z_alpha)-[w:Wire]-(x)
    WHERE x.t <> 0 AND (w.t <> 2 OR x.t <> 1) }
WITH z_alpha, bds[0] AS bd, bws[0].t AS bt
MATCH (z_alpha)-[pe:Wire {t: 2}]-(z_j:_ZXdbPivotEligible {graph_id: $graph_id})
WITH z_j, z_alpha, bd, bt, id(pe) AS rank
// Candidates sharing alpha cannot coexist. Retain its lowest-ranked partner.
WITH z_j, z_alpha, bd, bt, rank ORDER BY rank
WITH z_alpha, bd, bt, head(collect({j:z_j, rank:rank})) AS choice
WITH choice.j AS z_j, z_alpha, bd, bt, choice.rank AS rank
// Avoid redundant neighbor labels: these cause per-candidate ScanAll plans
// on Memgraph 3.6.2 instead of expansion from the bound centers.
CALL {
  WITH z_j
  OPTIONAL MATCH (z_j)-[:Wire]-(nj)
  RETURN collect(DISTINCT nj) AS j_claim
}
CALL {
  WITH z_alpha
  OPTIONAL MATCH (z_alpha)-[:Wire]-(na)
  RETURN collect(DISTINCT na) AS a_claim
}
WITH z_j, z_alpha, bd, bt, rank, j_claim, a_claim ORDER BY rank
WITH collect({j: z_j, a: z_alpha, bd: bd, bt: bt, rank: rank,
              claim: [z_j, z_alpha, bd] + j_claim + a_claim}) AS candidates
CALL {
  MATCH (v:_ZXdbPivotEligible {graph_id: $graph_id})
  REMOVE v:_ZXdbPivotEligible
}
// Greedy disjoint claims avoid copying whole neighborhoods into a conflict table.
WITH reduce(selected = {used: [], matches: []}, candidate IN candidates |
  CASE WHEN any(v IN candidate.claim WHERE v IN selected.used) THEN selected
       ELSE {used: selected.used + candidate.claim,
             matches: selected.matches + [candidate]} END) AS selected
UNWIND selected.matches AS candidate
WITH candidate.j AS z_j, candidate.a AS z_alpha, candidate.bd AS bd, candidate.bt AS bt
OPTIONAL MATCH (z_j)-[:Wire {t: 2}]-(nj)
WHERE nj <> z_alpha
WITH z_j, z_alpha, bd, bt, collect(DISTINCT nj) AS j_nbrs
OPTIONAL MATCH (z_alpha)-[:Wire {t: 2}]-(na)
WHERE na <> z_j AND na <> bd
WITH z_j, z_alpha, bd, bt, j_nbrs, collect(DISTINCT na) AS a_nbrs
WITH z_j, z_alpha, bd, bt,
     [x IN j_nbrs WHERE NOT x IN a_nbrs] AS only_j,
     [x IN a_nbrs WHERE NOT x IN j_nbrs] AS only_alpha,
     [x IN j_nbrs WHERE x IN a_nbrs] AS shared

CALL {
  WITH only_j, only_alpha
  UNWIND only_j AS u
  // Expand each source once, rather than once per potential target.
  OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[existing:Wire {t: 2}]-(neighbor)
  WHERE neighbor IN only_alpha
  WITH u, only_alpha, collect(existing) AS existing_edges, collect(neighbor) AS connected
  WITH u, existing_edges, [v IN only_alpha WHERE NOT v IN connected] AS missing
  FOREACH (edge IN existing_edges | DELETE edge)
  // Simple edges remain; a new parallel H edge is normalized by the caller.
  FOREACH (v IN missing |
    CREATE (u)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: u.graph_id}]->(v))
}

CALL {
  WITH only_j, shared
  UNWIND only_j AS u
  // Expand each source once, rather than once per potential target.
  OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[existing:Wire {t: 2}]-(neighbor)
  WHERE neighbor IN shared
  WITH u, shared, collect(existing) AS existing_edges, collect(neighbor) AS connected
  WITH u, existing_edges, [v IN shared WHERE NOT v IN connected] AS missing
  FOREACH (edge IN existing_edges | DELETE edge)
  // Simple edges remain; a new parallel H edge is normalized by the caller.
  FOREACH (v IN missing |
    CREATE (u)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: u.graph_id}]->(v))
}

CALL {
  WITH only_alpha, shared
  UNWIND only_alpha AS u
  // Expand each source once, rather than once per potential target.
  OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[existing:Wire {t: 2}]-(neighbor)
  WHERE neighbor IN shared
  WITH u, shared, collect(existing) AS existing_edges, collect(neighbor) AS connected
  WITH u, existing_edges, [v IN shared WHERE NOT v IN connected] AS missing
  FOREACH (edge IN existing_edges | DELETE edge)
  // Simple edges remain; a new parallel H edge is normalized by the caller.
  FOREACH (v IN missing |
    CREATE (u)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: u.graph_id}]->(v))
}

FOREACH (n IN only_j |
  SET n.phase = (coalesce(n.phase, 0) + z_alpha.phase) % 2)
FOREACH (n IN only_alpha |
  SET n.phase = (coalesce(n.phase, 0) + z_j.phase) % 2)
FOREACH (n IN shared |
  SET n.phase = (coalesce(n.phase, 0) + z_j.phase + z_alpha.phase + 1) % 2)
CREATE (z_j)-[:Wire {t: CASE bt WHEN 1 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END, graph_id: z_j.graph_id}]->(bd)
DETACH DELETE z_alpha
RETURN count(*) AS interior_pauli_removed

// Group equal neighborhoods once, before considering phase-compatible pairs.
MATCH (v:Node {graph_id: $graph_id, t: 1})
WHERE v.phase IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT (v)-[:Wire {t: 1}]-()
  AND NOT (v)-[:Wire]-(v) AND v.phase * 2 <> round(v.phase * 2)
OPTIONAL MATCH (v)-[:Wire]-(n)
WITH DISTINCT v, n
ORDER BY id(n)
WITH v, collect(n) AS neighbors
WHERE degree(v) = size(neighbors)
  AND ALL(n IN neighbors WHERE n.t = 1)
WITH v, neighbors AS neighborhood
WITH neighborhood, collect(v) AS spiders
WHERE size(spiders) > 1
UNWIND spiders AS v
UNWIND spiders AS w
WITH v, w, neighborhood
WHERE id(v) < id(w)
  AND ((v.phase + w.phase) % 2 = 1 OR abs((v.phase - w.phase) % 2) = 1)
  AND NOT (v)-[:Wire]-(w)
WITH v, w, neighborhood AS v_neigh
ORDER BY id(v), id(w)
LIMIT 1

FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN (v.phase + w.phase) % 2 = 1 THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
  FOREACH (n IN v_neigh |
    FOREACH (__ IN CASE WHEN n.phase IS NOT NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
      SET n.phase = (n.phase + 1) % 2
    )
  )
)

WITH v, w
DETACH DELETE v, w

RETURN count(*) AS supplementarity_applied

// Group equal neighborhoods once, before considering phase-compatible pairs.
MATCH (v:Node {graph_id: $graph_id, t: 1})
WHERE v.phase IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT (v)-[:Wire {t: 1}]-()
  AND NOT (v)-[:Wire]-(v) AND v.phase * 2 <> round(v.phase * 2)
OPTIONAL MATCH (v)-[:Wire]-(n)
WITH DISTINCT v, n
ORDER BY id(n)
WITH v, collect(n) AS neighbors
WHERE degree(v) = size(neighbors)
  AND ALL(n IN neighbors WHERE n.t = 1)
UNWIND neighbors + [v] AS member
WITH DISTINCT v, member
ORDER BY id(member)
WITH v, collect(member) AS neighborhood
WITH neighborhood, collect(v) AS spiders
WHERE size(spiders) > 1
UNWIND spiders AS v
UNWIND spiders AS w
WITH v, w, neighborhood
WHERE id(v) < id(w)
  AND ((v.phase + w.phase) % 2 = 0 OR abs((v.phase - w.phase) % 2) = 1)
  AND (v)-[:Wire]-(w)
WITH v, w, [n IN neighborhood WHERE n <> v AND n <> w] AS v_ext_neigh
ORDER BY id(v), id(w)
LIMIT 1

FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN (v.phase + w.phase) % 2 = 0 THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
  FOREACH (n IN v_ext_neigh |
    FOREACH (__ IN CASE WHEN n.phase IS NOT NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
      SET n.phase = (n.phase + 1) % 2
    )
  )
)

WITH v, w
DETACH DELETE v, w

RETURN count(*) AS supplementarity_applied

// Spider self-loops: a simple loop is a nonzero scalar; an H loop adds pi.
// Use directed matching so each stored relationship is counted exactly once.
MATCH (n:Node {graph_id: $graph_id})-[e:Wire]->(n)
WHERE n.t IN [1, 2] AND e.t IN [1, 2]
WITH n, collect(e) AS loops, sum(CASE WHEN e.t = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS flips
SET n.phase = ((coalesce(n.phase, 0) + flips) % 2 + 2) % 2
FOREACH (e IN loops | DELETE e)
RETURN sum(size(loops)) AS removed
